title: Support Systems Lead (NYC)
description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

As a Support Systems Lead at Replit, you'll build and own the systems that let support scale as fast as the product does. You'll own the tools our team works in every day, the technical setup behind self-service and AI-driven support, and the infrastructure that keeps all of it current as Replit ships.

Replit is at the forefront of AI-driven software development, and how we support customers is constantly evolving. You'll shape how our support systems adapt to new products, new surfaces, and AI-assisted workflows, operating effectively in ambiguity and turning ad hoc fixes into infrastructure the whole team can rely on.

You'll combine hands-on technical depth with systems thinking to keep builders moving, whether they get unblocked through self-service, an AI agent, or a person. This is an individual contributor role to start, with room to grow and build out a team as support scales.

IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

- Configure and maintain Zendesk and the surrounding support stack, from the day-to-day workflow and automation setup to business rules and permissions, keeping it able to flex and scale as needs change.

- Build and maintain assignment logic, queues, tagging and taxonomy, and escalation paths, keeping them running cleanly as volume and workflows change.

- Set up and maintain support tooling, workflows, and access across internal agents, outsourced vendors, and regions, keeping the systems working for each group as the stack changes.

- Partner with Engineering on the technical requirements for self-service and in-product support surfaces, and build the entry points, help widgets, and routing behind them.

- Spot the repetitive steps in agent and admin workflows before they become bottlenecks, and build the automations, bulk actions, and scripts, including in Replit, that take them out.

- Take in tooling and systems requests from across support, run tool and vendor evaluations for the support stack, and lead a migration if we change platforms.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

- 5+ years in support operations, support systems, tooling, or a similar technical operations role.

- Hands-on administration of a ticketing platform like Zendesk: building triggers and automations, macros, views, and SLAs, and managing routing, groups, and permissions.

- Experience building and maintaining integrations across SaaS tools using APIs and webhooks.

- Comfortable troubleshooting directly and working with engineers on more complex system needs.

- Strong judgment about prioritization in fast-moving, sometimes ambiguous environments.

- Comfort taking on cross-functional problems, including ones that sit between support, tooling, and engineering

NICE TO HAVE:

- Has used Replit in the last 3 to 6 months.

- Scripting with Python or similar to build automations, bulk actions, and internal tooling.

- Experience standing up self-service or in-product support surfaces.

- Experience making systems work across both BPO and in-house teams.

- Zendesk certification.

This is a full-time role that can be held from our NYC office. This role has an in-office requirement.

title: Transitions of Care RN Case Manager
description:
Job Description
A bit about this role:
We want to help patients navigate the healthcare system in a better and safer way, and case management is critical to achieving this for our most vulnerable and complex patients. You'll be responsible for providing telephonic, short-term, interdisciplinary care management in the 30 days post-discharge for patients at high risk for readmission. You'll serve as an advocate for these patients, coordinating care and ensuring they have the necessary resources and support to achieve better health outcomes.
Our ideal RN is caring, compassionate, solution-oriented and enthusiastic about providing an outstanding experience for Devoted Health ’s patients. They are committed to integrity, excellence, and empowering our patients to confidently navigate the healthcare system and live healthier lives. They are ready to innovate, adaptable to a continuously evolving startup environment, working with the whole Devoted family to create a revolution in how care is delivered.
Your Responsibilities and Impact will include:
Working with patients

• Engaging with our newly discharged patients telephonically to understand their needs, supported by technology and data tools.

• Conducting assessments to identify comorbid conditions, ED/hospitalization history, medications, psychosocial factors, and patient values and preferences.

• Developing care plans in partnership with patients and their caregivers - problems, goals, interventions - while continuously evaluating the patient’s progress.

• Explaining complicated medical terms in plain language.

• Educating patients on their chronic conditions including teaching “red flags,” developing plans during an exacerbation, and identifying barriers to important care elements such as medication adherence.

• Hearing the red flags and providing active care management to close the gaps.

Working with other providers and resources

• Partnering with the TOC Nurse Practitioners and Physicians to ensure smooth handoffs, comprehensive follow-up, and coordinated care during the post-discharge period.

• Referring patients to Devoted Medical when applicable and working closely on partnering for patient care.

• Working closely with Devoted Community Guides (locally-based social workers) to identify community-based organizations to support our patients in meeting their goals.

• Coordinating post-treatment care and DME needs.

• Collaborating closely with our PCP partners, to coordinate care and deliver evidence based, effective, and accessible health care.

Required skills and experience:

• An unrestricted Compact RN license obtained in the United States with the ability to secure other licensure states

• 3-4 Years of Experience of RN Care Management/telephonic case management experience

• Working hours are Monday-Friday 8:30-5:00 MST/PST. We are looking for candidates who are located in CT/MT/PT time zones.

Desired skills and experience:

• Enthusiasm for working in a setting where meaningful time is spent on the phone with patients and/or their caregivers to build trust, educate, and coordinate care

• Comfort and confidence working in an environment guided by performance and productivity metrics, with a focus on quality outcomes and patient experience

• Health insurance experience, particularly Medicare Advantage

• Prior Special Needs Plan, Population Health, or Transitions of Care case/care management experience

• Clinical analytical thinking that allows you to apply your skills to the individual needs of each patient

• Telephonic care/case management experience

title: Account Executive
description:
Appen's Go to Market team sits at the center of the company's growth strategy, partnering with the world's most ambitious AI programs to deliver the data that makes models work. This role is responsible for acquiring net-new strategic logos and expanding high-value accounts across Big Tech, AI Labs, and Enterprise AI adopters. It's a high-visibility commercial role operating across Global and Americas markets.
Your Impact

You'll own end-to-end enterprise sales cycles, from discovery and qualification through commercial negotiation and contract execution, working from well-developed territory and account plans.

You'll stay multi-threaded across buying, technical, and operational stakeholders, positioning Appen's portfolio as the partner of choice by mapping capabilities directly to each client's AI program priorities. Expect to craft compelling business cases and proposals, and to run regular Executive Business Reviews to keep clients aligned on strategic goals and surface new partnership opportunities.

Pipeline comes from outbound account-based strategies run in partnership with Marketing, backed by strong CRM discipline and accurate, timely forecasts. You'll also orchestrate internal teams across Client Partners, Delivery, Legal, and Finance to shape the solution and pricing behind each bid.

Success in this role looks like year-on-year growth in the accounts you own, and enough standing inside them to influence how those programs are scoped and resourced.

• A proven track record of closing complex enterprise deals gained selling directly into frontier AI labs in the AI training data, RLHF, or model evaluation space.

• Exceptional communication skills with enough technical credibility to influence engineering and research stakeholders, and C-suite.

• The ability to lead complex RFP responses and negotiate MSAs, SOWs, DPAs, and other enterprise agreements.

title: Mechanical Technician
description:
SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge.  Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

We are seeking a Mechanical Technician to support the buildout and operation of SpaceXAI's high-performance data centers. In this hands-on role, you will provide mechanical general labor and field support that keeps construction and commissioning moving on our next-generation AI supercomputing infrastructure.

You will work closely with mechanical, plumbing, electrical, and operations teams to stage materials, assist installs, and maintain a safe, productive jobsite from construction through turnover. This is a full-time, onsite role with significant travel to SpaceXAI data center sites.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Stage, move, and inventory pipe, valves, hangers, insulation, tools, and equipment; keep laydown yards and mechanical rooms orderly.

• Assist skilled trades with hanging strut, supports, lagging, insulation, bolt-up, and simple mechanical assembly under direction of a lead technician or journeyman.

• Support equipment set for pumps, cooling towers, air handlers, and related mechanical gear, including cribbing, alignment assist, and housekeeping.

•  Open and close work areas: protection, debris removal, scrap segregation, and end-of-shift reset so the next crew can start immediately.

• Fetch tools and materials, run parts between warehouse and field, and keep consumables stocked.

• Follow LOTO, PPE, and permit rules; do not work on live systems without authorization.

• Report damaged material, unsafe conditions, and drawing conflicts immediately.

•  Support punch-list work and cleanup through system turnover.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• 1+ year of construction, warehouse, manufacturing, or mechanical-helper experience, or equivalent military experience.

• Willingness to work at heights, outdoors, and on a changing construction site.

• Ability to use basic hand tools, power tools, and material-handling equipment safely.

• Strong safety mindset and willingness to follow site procedures.

• Willingness to work extended hours, nights, and weekends during critical construction windows.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Prior experience on industrial, mechanical, or data center construction sites.

• Familiarity with pallet jacks, basic rigging, and mechanical fasteners.

• OSHA 10 or equivalent training.

• Ability to read simple plans or spool sheets.

• High school diploma or equivalency certificate.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Ability to travel extensively to SpaceXAI construction sites and remain onsite during peak construction phases.

• Capability to work in industrial environments, climb ladders, lift moderate loads, stand and walk for a full shift, and wear PPE for extended periods.

What You'll Do

The Warsaw team is CoreWeave's EMEA hub for Hardware Compute, focusing primarily on CoreWeave Omni-our model for deploying and operating the CoreWeave Cloud Platform inside customer- and partner-owned data centres. We build, scale, and maintain the infrastructure behind high-density GPU systems, where GPU health, diagnostics, and interconnect telemetry are first-class engineering challenges across diverse hardware platforms and vendor configurations.

As a Hardware Engineer, GPU Infrastructure, you will own GPU and interconnect health across the fleet, combining hands-on engineering with operational support. Partnering with data centre operations teams, server OEMs, and vendors such as NVIDIA, you will lead deep root-cause analysis across hardware, firmware, drivers, and PCIe topologies to drive long-term fixes. • In-depth knowledge of server hardware, components, and management technologies, particularly GPUs and PCIe devices.

• Proficiency in Python or Ansible, with experience programmatically interacting with server BMCs using Redfish or IPMI (Redfish preferred).

• Hands-on experience integrating and automating data centre GPU diagnostics, troubleshooting tools, and observability platforms (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana).

• Demonstrated experience collaborating with hardware vendors to identify novel issues, create operational playbooks, and drive RMAs to resolution.

• Proven experience supporting production infrastructure, driving incident escalations through to root-cause resolution, and participating in on-call rotations.

• Excellent technical documentation, analytical problem-solving skills, and fluency in written and spoken English.

Preferred:

• Experience bringing up new data centre regions or operating within customer/partner-owned facility infrastructure.

• Familiarity with rack-scale GPU platforms (e.g., NVIDIA GB200 / GB300), including NVLink, NVSwitch, and InfiniBand fabrics.

• Experience with NVIDIA diagnostic tooling, GPU driver and firmware lifecycle management, and fleet-scale BMC management interfaces (Redfish/IPMI).

• Strong Linux systems administration and kernel-level debugging skills at fleet scale, including PCIe enumeration.

• Familiarity with Kubernetes-based services and distributed production environments.

We are seeking a strategic, analytical, and systems-minded Portfolio Planner to translate Oklo's project portfolio into an integrated organizational resource and staffing plan. This role will establish and govern a common coding structure across project schedules, connect project milestones and phases to department-specific workload requirements, and develop repeatable demand models that account for project type, scale, complexity, maturity, and other relevant proxy metrics. The Portfolio Planner will work with project teams and department leaders to convert the portfolio roadmap into forward-looking capacity requirements, identify resource constraints, and inform the timing and mix of internal hiring, redeployment, and external support. The role will maintain a portfolio-wide view while Project Schedulers remain accountable for detailed project-level schedule development and status.

title: Social Media Lead
description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year - far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Social at Ramp exists to make the company more visible, culturally relevant, and useful to the people we want to reach. We are looking for a highly strategic Social Media Lead to turn that ambition into an operating system.

Your central job is to build the strategy and operating system for Ramp social. You will bring a clear point of view, make the right calls about where and how Ramp shows up, and ensure our biggest moments have real distribution behind them. You will help more Ramp employees credibly tell the stories closest to their work. You may also be hands-on where it matters, but strategic leadership and operational ownership are what will define success in this role.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Set Ramp’s social strategy, raise the creative bar, and focus the calendar on fewer, more consequential moments.

- Decide when Ramp, an employee, executive, creator, customer, or partner should lead the story, then build the right distribution plan around it.

- Help more Ramplings and executives post credibly about their work, with clear guidance, coaching, and amplification.

- Build a reliable approach to community management and social support, including the right contractor bench.

- Bring together producers, influencer, Brand, Comms, Growth, Support, and visibility teams to execute the highest-priority work.

- Establish a clear scorecard and use social insights to improve the work over time.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

- Ramp has a clear social point of view, distinct roles for each channel, and a calendar built around high-conviction moments rather than constant posting.

- The social function is a strategic driver of visibility and demand, not an internal posting service.

- Employees and executives have an easy, trusted way to share their work, and the strongest posts receive coordinated amplification.

- Product questions and customer issues found on social are handled with dependable ownership and follow-through.

- Social has data driven goals and learnings, including reach, awareness, demand, campaign lift, and market insights.

WHAT YOU BRING

- 2+ years leading strategic social, or related marketing programs at a top-tier technology, consumer or media company.

- A demonstrated ability to build social strategy and the operating model behind it: prioritization, agency management, workflows, measurement, and executive alignment.

- Excellent editorial judgment and an instinct for what will feel credible and native on each platform, especially LinkedIn, X, Meta, YouTube, and emerging community channels.

- Comfort with performance and brand measurement, including how to distinguish correlation from impact and how to run disciplined tests.

HOW WE WORK

We make finance teams cool. That means taking ideas further, choosing fewer bets with more force, and creating work people genuinely want to talk about. We value sharp taste, clear thinking, generous collaboration, and the willingness to say no when a moment does not meet the bar.

Backend

Build and maintain FastAPI services that power compliance checks, document validation, and third party integrations

Design and implement durable, auditable workflow logic with a strong focus on traceability

Frontend

Implement clean, accessible user interfaces using shadcn ui and Tailwind, with opinionated defaults rather than custom CSS

Ship features end to end. You spec, build, test, and deploy

- Working within a team to Contribute to the overall performance by consistently meeting individual targets against vehicles listed & Pipeline conversion.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to provide insights and feedback, contributing to the overall growth and success of Carwow.

- Experience working within a target focused environment and managing a pipeline independently.

- Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to build rapport with sellers from diverse backgrounds.

We are on a mission to be the partner of choice for developing people and their communities. Reed Wellbeing is a public service provider delivering lifestyle and wellbeing programmes that help people improve their health.
Pay Range
£42,000 - £60,000 (Greater London)
£40,000 - £58,000 (London Region)
£38,000 - £55,000 (Outside London)
Job Description
Are you an experienced leader in mental health services with a passion for quality, governance and service excellence?
Do you thrive on building high-performing teams, driving continuous improvement and delivering outstanding outcomes for participants?
Consider the role of Head of Mental Health Services & Registered Manager at Reed Wellbeing.
Formed in 2015, Reed Wellbeing has expanded rapidly, developing and delivering evidence-based health and wellbeing services that improve outcomes for individuals and communities. Alongside our physical health and lifestyle programmes, we are committed to delivering safe, effective and person-centred mental health, counselling and psychotherapy services that make a meaningful difference to people's lives.
Working in partnership with commissioners, healthcare providers and community organisations, our services are designed to support individuals to achieve better health and wellbeing outcomes through accessible, high-quality interventions.
What the job is about
The Head of Mental Health Services & Registered Manager provides strategic, operational and clinical leadership across Reed Wellbeing's mental health services portfolio. Acting as the CQC Registered Manager, you will be accountable for service quality, regulatory compliance, clinical governance, safeguarding, operational performance and commissioner satisfaction.
This is a highly influential role where you will shape service delivery, embed a culture of quality and continuous improvement, and ensure participants receive safe, effective and evidence-based care. You will work closely with senior leaders, commissioners and regulatory bodies while leading multidisciplinary teams across a geographically dispersed service.
Your main responsibilities would be:

• Acting as the named Registered Manager with the Care Quality Commission (CQC).

• Ensuring compliance with CQC regulations, professional standards and clinical governance requirements.

• Leading preparation for inspections, regulatory reviews and audits.

• Providing senior leadership for clinical governance, quality assurance and risk management.

• Overseeing safeguarding arrangements and supporting complex safeguarding decisions.

• Leading operational delivery across mental health contracts and services.

• Managing commissioner and stakeholder relationships, including NHS organisations, Integrated Care Boards and Local Authorities.

• Monitoring service performance, quality indicators, participant outcomes and contractual targets.

• Supporting business growth, contract retention, mobilisation and service development activity.

• Leading, developing and inspiring multidisciplinary clinical and operational teams.

• Driving innovation, continuous improvement and service transformation initiatives.

• Providing oversight of business continuity, governance and organisational risk.

What's in it for you?
A competitive salary, flexible working arrangements and access to excellent development opportunities. You will also benefit from Reed in Partnership 's comprehensive employee benefits package, including:

• 25 days annual leave plus statutory bank holidays

• Reed Pension Scheme

• Award-winning Management & Leadership training

• Professional and Personal Development Funds

• Bi-annual pay reviews

• Career development and progression opportunities

• The opportunity to make a genuine difference to individuals, communities and mental health outcomes across the services you lead

At Reed in Partnership , we live and breathe our values. We are fair, open and honest; we take ownership; and we work together to achieve the best outcomes

description:
Job Purpose
The Business Analyst will act as the critical link between the Corporate Banking business (Liquidity & Cash Management) and Technology/Operations teams, translating business needs into clear functional requirements. The role supports the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of cash management products - including domestic and cross-border payments, liquidity structures (pooling, sweeping, notional pooling), virtual accounts, and digital banking channels - ensuring solutions meet client needs, regulatory requirements (SAMA), and internal risk/control standards.
Key Responsibilities

• Gather, analyze, and document business and functional requirements from Corporate Banking stakeholders for Liquidity & Cash Management products and platforms (e.g., host-to-host, API banking, virtual IBAN, liquidity pooling, sweeping structures).

• Act as a liaison between Business, IT, Operations, and third-party vendors throughout the project lifecycle - from requirements gathering through UAT and post-implementation support.

• Produce Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Specification Documents (FSDs), process flow diagrams, and user stories for change initiatives and new product launches.

• Support end-to-end delivery of cash management initiatives including cash pooling, sweeping/topping arrangements, notional pooling, and multi-currency account structures.

• Conduct gap analysis between current and target operating models, identifying process inefficiencies and automation opportunities.

• Collaborate with Product Managers to support the design and rollout of new liquidity management solutions aligned with client and market demands.

• Work closely with Compliance and Risk teams to ensure new products/features comply with SAMA regulations and internal governance frameworks.

• Coordinate and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including test case preparation, defect tracking, and sign-off coordination.

• Analyze transaction and liquidity data to identify trends, client behavior, and areas for product enhancement.

• Support RFP responses, client onboarding requirements, and due diligence documentation for corporate clients using liquidity/cash management services.

• Prepare MI reports, dashboards, and presentations for senior management on project status, product performance, and client usage.

• Maintain up-to-date process documentation and ensure knowledge transfer to Operations and support teams.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Information Systems, or a related field.

• Professional certification such as CBAP, CCM (Certified Cash Manager), or CTP (Certified Treasury Professional) is an advantage.

Experience

• Minimum 3-7 years of experience as a Business Analyst within Corporate/Transaction/Wholesale Banking, with specific exposure to Cash Management and/or Liquidity Management products.

• Proven experience working on cash management platforms (e.g., host-to-host connectivity, SWIFT, API banking, virtual accounts, liquidity structures).

• Experience working within Saudi or GCC banking environments preferred; familiarity with SAMA regulatory requirements is highly desirable.

• Experience with Agile/Scrum delivery methodology as well as traditional Waterfall project environments.

• Track record of managing relationships with cross-functional stakeholders (Product, IT, Operations, Compliance, Risk).

Skills & Competencies

• Strong understanding of corporate banking liquidity concepts: cash pooling, sweeping, notional pooling, multi-currency/multi-entity structures, interest optimization.

• Solid grasp of payment rails and cash management infrastructure (SARIE, SWIFT, RTGS, ACH, host-to-host, API connectivity).

• Excellent business requirements gathering, process mapping, and documentation skills (BRD/FSD, BPMN, UML basics).

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex data and processes.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Fraud
description:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

The Fraud Data team at Plaid builds the machine learning systems that power Plaid’s fraud detection products, leveraging insights from across Plaid’s network to help identify and stop fraud before it happens. Our team works across the full data science and machine learning lifecycle-from discovering new signals and experimenting with models to deploying and optimizing them in production. We continuously learn from real-world model performance and customer feedback to improve our systems and develop new ways to protect customers and consumers from evolving fraud threats.

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer on Plaid's Fraud Data team, you will develop models that improve fraud detection for our customers. You will identify predictive patterns in Plaid's network data and lead projects from initial experiments through model deployment and ongoing improvement.

- Investigate fraud patterns and model errors to identify new signals, improve detection, and expand coverage across customers and use cases.

- Develop training datasets and predictive features, addressing challenges such as incomplete labels, class imbalance, data leakage, and changing fraud behavior.

- Design, train, and tune models using traditional and modern ML methods, including gradient-boosted trees and neural networks, and evaluate newer architectures against existing approaches.

- Design experiments to test features and models, comparing performance across time periods and customer segments using agreed detection and false-positive metrics.

- Build data and training pipelines that support reproducible experiments and efficient iteration on features and models.

- Deploy models with Engineering and ML Infrastructure partners, balancing detection quality, latency, cost, and reliability.

- Independently lead ML projects, agreeing on priorities and evaluation metrics with Data Science and Product and coordinating work through model release.

Responsibilities:

- Build hands-on machine learning expertise across the full ML lifecycle, from feature engineering and experimentation to model deployment.

- Take models from initial experimentation through production and evaluate their impact using real-world customer outcomes.

- Develop experience building and scaling reliable ML systems in production.

- Explore how LLMs and Generative AI can improve fraud detection, prevention, and investigation.

- Accelerate your career in a fast-paced environment with opportunities to take ownership, solve complex problems, and make a meaningful impact.

Qualifications:

- 7+ years of professional experience in machine learning, applied science, or software engineering for ML, including hands-on model development and deployment.

- Hands-on experience designing, training, tuning, and deploying models, and measuring improvements in production performance or business metrics.

- Strong ML and statistical fundamentals, including feature engineering, experiment design, model evaluation, and diagnosing why a model underperforms.

- Strong understanding of the strengths, limitations, and applications for both traditional and modern ML methods, including gradient-boosted trees and neural networks.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
About Us

Chess.com is one of the largest gaming sites in the world and the #1 platform for playing, learning, and enjoying chess.

We are a team of 600+ fully remote people in 60+ countries working hard to serve the global chess community. We are here to support 250M+ chess players worldwide with the best possible product, content, and tools to serve the community!

We are a tech company. A gaming company. A content company. And we do it all with passion and commitment to the game. Above all we prize our mission-driven, flat, life-celebrating, no-corporate culture, and we look forward to meeting you and learning more about what you can bring to the team.

About You

First off, you love to play chess and want to help others discover that same joy. You are intimately familiar with Chess.com products and care deeply about what makes the experience fun, sticky, and rewarding for players of all levels.

Secondly, you have extensive experience as a product manager shipping consumer-facing products that drive engagement and retention. You have worked deeply with engineering teams to define what success looks like in an ambiguous environment. You communicate regularly and successfully to executive stakeholders.

Finally, you have technical know-how. You work closely with engineering all the way through to delivery and drive on execution. You talk through pipelines and data so you can have clear and productive conversations with engineering.

What you'll do

•
Shape the core product roadmap and vision. In close partnership with leadership, shape both the near-term roadmap and the long-term vision for the core Chess.com experience, making the product more fun, engaging, and enjoyable for players at every level. Identify what keeps players coming back, what causes them to leave, and what will delight them next.

•
Bring ideas and sharpen them with the team. Come with your own point of view on what's worth building and why. Engage with feedback from leadership and peers: internalize it, push back where you disagree, and use it to make the work better. The vision is built together; you're a strong, informed voice in it.

Operate in public. As a globally remote company spanning many time zones, async Slack communication is how decisions get made. Work out loud in channels: brainstorm openly, pose sharp questions, make decisive small calls with reasoning attached, and be explicit on what's urgent vs. not. Engage with depth and without ego, pull the right people in by name to build alignment. Make the most of sync meeting time by taking on the biggest questions.

•
Partner deeply with engineering, early and through to delivery. Shape the technical approach alongside engineering partners, write specs that are crisp on intent and honest about tradeoffs, and be a force driving through to execution. Unblock, reprioritize, and ship.

•
Own engagement metrics and move them. Define the metrics that matter for your area, build intuition for what drives them, and hold yourself accountable to moving them. Use data to prioritize ruthlessly, run experiments, and know when to trust your gut vs. wait for more signal.

•
Use AI to prototype, de-risk, and accelerate. Build mocks, test flows, and pressure-test ideas yourself before engineering invests. Bring working artifacts into discussions, not just decks.

•
Build delightful, fun mechanics that keep players engaged. Improve retention by identifying and emphasizing the moments that matter most in a user's journey. Turn one-time visitors into daily players by giving them something to look forward to, something to work toward, and something to celebrate.

•
4+ years in product management, with strong consumer product experience. You've shipped consumer-facing products that millions of people use and love.

title: Hydrus - Session Director - Swiss German (CH) - V2
description:
About the Project

Project Hydrus is a scripted and conversational audio data collection project. The recordings produced help build natural, everyday-sounding synthesized voices for conversational AI products - voices that sound like real people talking, not scripted performances.

As Session Director, you'll lead live recording sessions with Voice Contributors, guiding them through scripted scenarios to produce natural, conversational-quality audio. This hands-on role blends creative direction, coaching, and technical audio judgment - making scripted material sound authentic and unscripted, rather than recited, while keeping sessions moving at a natural pace.

What You'll Do

• Direct voice performers through scripted scenarios, coaching for natural, conversational delivery rather than verbatim recitation.

• Build quick scene context for performers (who, where, why) and improvise to fill narrative or dialogue gaps live, keeping sessions flowing naturally.

• Adapt scripted wording for natural phrasing and regional/dialect authenticity as needed.

• Monitor and correct technical audio quality in real time: mic technique, pacing, clarity, and background noise.

• Manage session pacing to meet recording targets without sacrificing performance quality, and maintain organized notes on adjustments and retakes.

• Create a supportive, low-pressure environment for performers, including those with limited prior voice experience.

What We're Looking For

Required

• Native fluency in the required language (with specific dialect), with a strong ear for natural, colloquial phrasing.

• Experience directing, coaching, or producing voice or audio talent (e.g., voice direction, casting direction, audio/podcast production, dubbing/ADR, or theater direction).

• Demonstrated ability to give clear, specific, actionable performance direction.

• Strong working knowledge of basic recording/mic technique (proximity, plosives, room noise, levels).

• Comfortable improvising and adjusting scripted material on the spot.

• Excellent interpersonal skills; able to build rapport quickly with performers of varying experience levels.

Preferred (nice to have, not required)

• Background in improv, theater direction, or acting coaching.

• Experience directing non-professional or first-time voice talent specifically.

• Familiarity with DAWs or recording software (e.g., Pro Tools, Adobe Audition, Reaper) for spot-checking audio quality.

Commitment & Compensation

• Estimated time: Approximately 8 hours calibration, plus supervision across two recording sessions of ~4 hours each per participant

• Work Type - Freelance Remote

Technical Recruiter is the seat where a recruiter proves they can run the entire tactical recruiting process - sourcing, screening, interviewing, and closing - across the full range of technical and cleared requisitions, no matter the complexity. Agile Defense needs recruiters who can be handed anything in the caseload and deliver, while they build the judgment, stakeholder trust, and process ownership that portfolio-level seniority requires.
This is a developmental seat on the way to Senior Technical Recruiter: you can do the work - all of it - but you're not yet accountable for a full portfolio of senior stakeholders or for mentoring others. That comes next.
Performance Objectives - What Success Requires
These are the outcomes that define success in this seat over your first year. They are not a list of duties - they are the results you'll be measured against.

• Independently run the full recruiting toolkit. Within 90 days, manage a caseload of full-cycle requisitions across the full range of technical and cleared complexity - sourcing, screening, interviewing, negotiating, and closing - with only light oversight from a Senior Technical Recruiter or Recruiting Lead.

First 90 Days

• You're running full-cycle reqs independently across the full range of complexity, with only light check-ins.
First 6 Months

• Hiring managers trust you directly, and you've identified and proposed the small project you'll own for the year.
First 12 Months

• You're a fully independent, reliable recruiter who can be handed anything in the tactical req workload - and you're ready for the portfolio ownership, mentoring, and senior-stakeholder responsibility that defines Senior Technical Recruiter.

You'll report to the VP of Talent Acquisition, work with a Lead Recruiter around prioritization, and carry a caseload across the full range of technical/cleared complexity - typically 12 to 18 concurrent requisitions - as part of a broader team recruiting across DoD, Fed Civ, Homeland Security, Combatant Command, and Fourth Estate customers.

Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

Toast is seeking a Senior Security Engineer to design, implement, and operate enterprise Data Loss Prevention and Secure Access Service Edge capabilities. The role will reduce data exfiltration risk, enable secure access to web, SaaS, private applications, and cloud services, and improve security coverage.

You will be a senior individual contributor and subject matter expert, within the Enterprise Security team and will closely partner with IT, Network Engineering, Legal, Privacy, Compliance, and application owners. Success requires hands-on engineering, design, operational ownership, and clear risk communication.

A day in the life (Responsibilities) 

Data Loss Prevention Engineering

• Own the DLP engineering roadmap and control lifecycle, from requirements and architecture through proof of concept, testing, phased deployment, tuning, operations, and continuous improvement.

• Design and operate controls for sensitive data across managed endpoints, email, web and network channels, SaaS and collaboration applications, cloud environments, and data repositories.

• Build and maintain data discovery and classification logic using sensitive information types, regular expressions, data matching, document fingerprinting, OCR, and machine learning where appropriate.

• Translate requirements into precise policies and response actions with documented exceptions.

• Define dashboards and metrics for coverage, control effectiveness, detection precision, recurring exfiltration paths, policy exceptions, incident volume, and time to resolution.

Secure Access Service Edge Engineering

• Engineer and operate scalable SASE capabilities for corporate fleet, SaaS, private apps, and cloud environments.

• Configure and optimize core capabilities including secure web gateway, cloud access security broker, zero trust network access, firewall as a service, DNS security, remote browser isolation, DLP, digital experience monitoring, and SD-WAN or SSE integrations.

• Manage traffic steering and connectivity patterns such as endpoint clients, browser or proxy configurations, private application connectors, IPsec or GRE tunnels, and branch or cloud on ramps.

• Lead phased migrations from legacy VPN, proxy, and perimeter security solutions while maintaining service continuity, policy consistency, and a reliable end-user experience.

• Create context-aware access and data protection policies using device posture, application risk, destination, data sensitivity, and session risk signals.

• Develop TLS inspection standards, certificate deployment practices, bypass criteria, privacy safeguards, and documented exception processes in partnership with relevant stakeholders.

• Monitor availability, latency, tunnel and connector health, service edge performance, and policy impact; troubleshoot access and application performance issues across endpoint, network, and cloud layers.

• Design for resilience through regional failover, redundant connectivity, configuration standards, observability, tested recovery procedures and controlled automation.

• Experience: 7+ years of experience, including substantial hand

title: Regio Service Coördinator
description:
Ben jij een ervaren servicemonteur die graag verantwoordelijkheid neemt en collega’s helpt groeien? Zoek je een functie waarin jouw technische vakmanschap direct bijdraagt aan de kwaliteit van zorg? Dan is de rol van Regio Service Coördinator iets voor jou.
Je bent niet alleen technisch specialist, maar ook een coach, sparringpartner en kwaliteitsbewaker. Dankzij jouw kennis blijven zorghulpmiddelen veilig en betrouwbaar in gebruik én help je collega’s om iedere dag het beste uit zichzelf te halen.
Wat ga je doen:
Vanuit huis vertrek je met een goed uitgeruste servicebus naar klanten in jouw regio. Je werkt op locatie bij onze klanten en bent hét aanspreekpunt voor complexe technische vraagstukken. Je neemt collega’s mee in jouw kennis en ervaring, en zet de klant centraal.
Je werkzaamheden zijn:

• Uitvoeren van onderhoud aan de zorghulpmiddelen, inclusief het oplossen van complexe storingen en het uitvoeren van wettelijke keuringen

• Zorgdragen voor volledige en correcte registratie van onderhoud, keuringen en storingsoplossingen

• Initiëren, coördineren en uitvoeren van kwaliteitscontroles om de kwaliteit te waarborgen

• Coördineren en voorbereiden van onderhoudsprojecten op locatie, samen met collega’s en externe partijen

• Adviseren en communiceren met klanten over reparaties en technische verbeteringen

• Begeleiden en coachen van minder ervaren/nieuwe collega’s

• Signaleren van verbeterkansen en bewaken van kwaliteit, veiligheid en NEN-richtlijnen, beschrijven van processen en zorgen voor een eenduidige werkwijze binnen de teams

Je krijgt veel vrijheid om je werk zelfstandig in te richten en speelt een belangrijke rol in het continu verbeteren van onze dienstverlening.
Requirements
Wat vragen we van jou:
Je bent een ervaren servicemonteur die graag verantwoordelijkheid neemt en energie krijgt van het delen van kennis. Je houdt overzicht, werkt nauwkeurig en denkt in oplossingen. Je vindt het leuk om collega’s verder te helpen en weet klanten op een professionele en prettige manier te adviseren. Je voelt je thuis in een dynamische werkomgeving waarin geen dag hetzelfde is en waar flexibiliteit belangrijk is.

• Heb je MBO werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in de richting elektrotechniek of werktuigbouwkunde

• Heb je coachende vaardigheden

We are seeking a Workday Developer with broad expertise across Workday configuration, reporting, calculated fields, business process design, and Workday Extend application development. The role spans technical configuration, custom report design, integration support, and lightweight application extension work, helping HR, finance, and IT stakeholders get more value from the Workday platform. title: Remote Device Clinician - Full-Time
description:
A Rhythm Remote Device Clinician remotely monitors patients with cardiac implantable electronic devices (CIEDs) utilizing Rhythm ’s proprietary software. This specialist employs knowledge of cardiac electrophysiology and biomedical engineering concepts to assess the technical function of the patient’s CIED, analyze and interpret device and patient diagnostics, and perform accurate clinical documentation as determined by Rhythm ’s best practice standards.
Rhythm offers full-time employees a robust compensation and benefits package including health, dental, and vision coverage, 401k retirement savings with company match, paid time off and more.
Key Responsibilities:

• Integrate a knowledge base from physiology, pathophysiology, and cardiac device function to perform competent evaluations, diagnostic reviews, and overall analysis through remote monitoring.

• Recognize abnormal functions of pacemakers, defibrillators, ILRs, and CRT devices, and recommend strategies to address and correct issues.

• Communicate with Rhythm ’s clinical team and providers regarding CIED function and diagnostic data through accurate, professional, and standardized documentation.

• Maintain confidentiality of sensitive information and adhere to all Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) and Protected Health Information (PHI) standards/protocols.

• Support and contribute to Rhythm ’s patient-centered care philosophy: Every team member is a caregiver whose role is to meet the needs of the patient.

Requirements

• Bachelor's or associate degree required OR experience in a related field-nursing, medicine, electronics, or engineering.

• Successful completion of a cardiac device rhythm management course or equivalent experience.

• 2+ years of recent implanted cardiac device management experience with knowledge of all manufacturer programmers.

• 3+ years cardiology experience, cardiac electrophysiology preferred.

• Experience with interrogating and interpreting device diagnostics for all four major manufacturers (Medtronic, Abbott/St. Jude, Boston Scientific, Biotronik).

• Cardiac rhythm management industry training and experience preferred.

• Certified Rhythm Analysis Technician (CRAT) required prior to employment commencement date.

• Additional preferred certifications-Certified Cardiographic Technician (CCT), Registered Cardiac Electrophysiology Specialist (RCES), International Board of Heart Rhythm Examiners (IBHRE) Certifications (CCDS, CEPS, CDRMS) also preferred, prior to employment date.

• Proficiency with collaboration applications and software (Microsoft Office Suite, Teams).

Benefits

• Fully Remote: You’ll need access to a quiet working environment, high speed internet. We’ll provide you with a computer and additional monitor to support your work.

• Schedule: You operate within our business hours (9a-5p ET Monday through Friday). We can be slightly flexible on hours depending on location.

• Salary range: $70,000-$75,000 depending on experience; Clinicians are incentivized to bonus and have the ability to make an additional $10,000+ annually based on the number of reports completed.
